title: Great views from the top
text: Easy process. Turn up and show your ticket and they give you a physical ticket with a qr code. You need to buy a separate ticket to access the castle at the top though.  Without that ticket I don’t think you can see the views. Worth trying to buy a combined ticket if such a thing exists.  The castle itself was very interesting.
author: Cheryl_S

title: Stunning views
text: Great views of the city! Just know your way to it might require some research
author: luissetten

title: Fun on the funicular
text: We knew the wait would be long at the time we went but the line moved fairly quickly. There was no wait from the top. The castle was great.
author: S4727YDcherylh

title: Perfect views and no...
text: Perfect views and no queues. Lots of cable cars and easy access. Very fast entry and lovely at the top.
author: Sarah_V

title: Great views of Barcelona...
text: Great views of Barcelona from the cable cars. Easy on and off ride. Views from top are amazing. Castle at top worth a visit too
author: Sharon_J

title: Nice time
text: Quick and easy, great views.  Cool castle at the top.  Quick lines.  No complaints.  We would do it again
author: Thomas_Z

title: Stroll in the heights of Barcelona.
text: Very beautiful viewpoint and a very pleasant hike. In June, there are not too many people, so we were able to enjoy it more easily.
author: Isabelle_B

title: Great activity for the...
text: Great activity for the cost. Highly recommended. Take the cable car to the top of Montjuic and see the castle. Stay as long as you want then take it back to where you started. If you take the metro it connects with a tunnel, so you are only outside for a few moments.
author: Madalitso_A

title: Value for money and great views
text: We bought tickets on line , only a small que for ten minutes. Worth buying the return as we were sharing a cab on the way up with other people , on the way down we were able to swap sides and have a better view and photograph opportunities. Amazing view of the city from above.
author: Cindy_H

title: Best Experience.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text:
Magnificent view and great experience. 
I will do it again if I come back.
I will recommend it for a couple..
author: Jhayar_C
